```{r setup, include=F}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(pheatmap)
library(eulerr)
library(tidyverse)
library(deming)
source("scripts/helpers.R")

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 5,
  fig.height = 5,
  dpi = 600,
  fig.show = "hold",
  out.width = "50%"
)
```

```{r read data, include=F}
source("scripts/main-data.R")
source("scripts/compare-genelists-function.R")
```

```{r themes}

# a consistent color scale

goi_up = dea %>%
  filter(
    FDR <= 0.05,
    log2fold >= 1
  ) %>%
  pull(Gene) %>%
  unique()

up_mat = mat[goi_up, ]

myColors = generic_l2f_heatmap_colors(
  up_mat,
  scaleType = "symmetric",
  clipFactor = 0.995
)

# column splits 

myColsplits = factor(
  c(
    rep("WT", 4),
    rep("sham", 4),
    rep("TAK1KO", 4),
    rep("KO + lipid", 4),
    rep("rescue", 4),
    rep("mutant rescue", 4)
  ),
  levels = c(
    "WT",
    "sham",
    "TAK1KO",
    "KO + lipid",
    "rescue",
    "mutant rescue"
  )
)

# a prism-like ggplot2 theme

theme_prismLike = theme_bw() +
    theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(-0.15, "cm"),
    axis.ticks.y.right = element_line(),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6)
  )

cleanup_objects()
```

## Repeating wt_up_738 analyses on downregulated genes

258 DEGs downregulated by IL-1β (<0.5-fold, P ≤ 0.05) 

Check everything in relation to wt_dn_258... I left out KO_lipid as this group had 0 genes.

```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=4}
wt_dn_258 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "WT", sig == "dn") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

sham_dn_262 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "sham", sig == "dn") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

ko_dn_1 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "TAK1KO", rescue == "naive", sig == "dn") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

lipid_dn_0 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "TAK1KO", rescue == "lipid", sig == "dn") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

rescue_dn_72 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "TAK1KO", rescue == "TAK1-smRNA", sig == "dn") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

mutant_dn_13 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "TAK1KO", rescue == "mTAK1-smRNA", sig == "dn") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

for (name in c(
  "sham_dn_262",
  "ko_dn_1",
  # "lipid_dn_0",
  "rescue_dn_72",
  "mutant_dn_13"
)) {
  
  plot_gene_sets(
    list(
      wt_dn_258 = wt_dn_258,
      set = get(name)
    ) %>% setNames(c("wt_dn_258", name)),
    show_heatmap = F
  )
}

# write gene lists and sleuth results

group_lists = list()

for (name in c(
  "wt_dn_258",
  "sham_dn_262",
  "ko_dn_1",
  "lipid_dn_0",
  "rescue_dn_72",
  "mutant_dn_13"
)) {
  
  l = get(name)
  
  g = case_when(
    name == "wt_dn_258" ~ "WT_naive",
    name == "sham_dn_262" ~ "sham_naive",
    name == "ko_dn_1" ~ "TAK1KO_naive",
    name == "lipid_dn_0" ~ "TAK1KO_lipid",
    name == "rescue_dn_72" ~ "TAK1KO_TAK1-smRNA",
    name == "mutant_dn_13" ~ "TAK1KO_mTAK1-smRNA"
  )
  
  df = dea %>%
    filter(Gene %in% l, group == g)
  
  group_lists[[name]] = df
}

writexl::write_xlsx(group_lists, "data/venn-down-group-genelists.xlsx")



cleanup_objects()

```



## Downregulated: WT vs sham...

Q1a: How many genes downreg in sham compared to wt? **AG: overlap looks reasonable. 64.7% of wt_dn_258 is also downregulated in sham. For reference this number was 87.4% in wt_up_738.**

```{r}

wt_dn_258 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "WT", sig == "dn") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

sham_dn_262 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "sham", sig == "dn") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

genelists = list(
  wt_dn_258 = wt_dn_258,
  sham_dn_262 = sham_dn_262
)

plot_gene_sets(
  genelists,
  mat,
  # mat_cols = 1:8,
  colorScale = myColors,
  heatmapColsplits = myColsplits,
  plotType = "euler"
)
```

Q1a.1: effect of just going with the P-value (i.e., drop fold criteria?) Does it collapse into a single group. **AG: good collapse into 94.2% from Q1a. Suggests more per-rep variation in downregulated genes compared to upreg.**

```{r}

wt_dn_258 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "WT", sig == "dn") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

sham_dn_262 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "sham", sig == "dn") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

union = unique(c(wt_dn_258, sham_dn_262))

# pull pool genes, then drop to pvalue criteria only only

wt_up_l2f_dropped = dea %>%
  filter(condition == "WT", Gene %in% union) %>%
  filter(FDR <= 0.05, log2fold < 0) %>%
  pull(Gene)

sham_up_l2f_dropped = dea %>%
  filter(condition == "sham", Gene %in% union) %>%
  filter(FDR <= 0.05, log2fold < 0) %>%
  pull(Gene)

genelists = list(
  wt_up_l2f_dropped = wt_up_l2f_dropped,
  sham_up_l2f_dropped = sham_up_l2f_dropped
)

plot_gene_sets(
  genelists,
  mat,
  # mat_cols = 1:8,
  colorScale = myColors,
  heatmapColsplits = myColsplits,
  plotType = "euler"
)

cleanup_objects()

```

Q1a.2: correlations for wt_dn_258: WT vs sham. **AG: good correlation, slightly worse than upregulated.**

```{r, fig.height=2, fig.width=4}

wt_dn_258 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "WT", sig == "dn") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

df = tpm %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = unique(group))) %>%
  filter(
    Gene %in% wt_dn_258,
    group %in% c("WT_naive", "sham_naive"),
    treatment == "IL1B"
  ) %>%
  select(Gene, group, log2fold) %>%
  group_by(Gene, group) %>%
  summarize(log2fold = mean(log2fold), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "group", values_from = "log2fold")

pearson = cor.test(df[,2][[1]], df[,3][[1]], method = "pearson")$estimate[[1]]

deming = deming(sham_naive~WT_naive, df)
deming_intercept = deming$coefficients[[1]]
deming_slope = deming$coefficients[[2]]

info = paste0(
  "Pearson=", round(pearson, 2), 
  "; slope=", round(deming_slope, 2),
  "; intercept=", round(deming_intercept, 2)
  )


ggplot(df, aes(x = WT_naive, y = sham_naive)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, fill = "white") +
  geom_abline(slope = deming_slope, intercept = deming_intercept, color = "blue") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_prismLike +
  labs(caption = info) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, -4.2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, -4.2))

cleanup_objects()
```

Q1b: In how many genes is the IL1B response affected by sham (P<= 0.05)? **AG: no sham effects are significant.**

```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=4}
sham_il1b_interaction = read_tsv("data/sham_IL1B_interaction_test.txt")

wt_dn_258 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "WT", sig == "dn") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

df = as.data.frame(wt_dn_258, nm = "Gene") %>%
  left_join(
    sham_il1b_interaction %>% 
      select(Gene, log2diff, FDR)
    )

hist(df$log2diff, breaks = 100)
# summary(df$log2diff)

hist(df$FDR, breaks = 100)
# summary(df$FDR)

df %>%
  mutate(
    direction = case_when(
      log2diff == 0  ~ "0 or NA log2diff",
      log2diff <= 0 ~ "-ve log2diff",
      log2diff >= 0  ~ "+ve log2diff"
    )
  ) %>%
  count(direction) %>%
  mutate(percent = 100*n/sum(n)) %>%
  knitr::kable(full_width = FALSE)

df %>%
  mutate(sig = if_else(FDR <= 0.05, "FDR<=0.05", "ns")) %>%
  count(sig) %>%
  mutate(percent = 100*n/sum(n)) %>%
  knitr::kable(full_width = FALSE)

cleanup_objects()
```

## Downregulated: WT vs KO...

Q2a: how many genes downreg in KO compared to wt? **AG: no wt_dn_258 genes remain downreg in the absence of TAK1. One unique downregulation: ADAMTS15. RNAseq explorer suggests slight change in baseline expression following KO, but mostly noise around low expression.**

```{r}
wt_dn_258 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "WT", sig == "dn") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

ko_dn_1 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "TAK1KO", rescue == "naive", sig == "dn") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

genelists = list(
  wt_dn_258 = wt_dn_258,
  ko_dn_1 = ko_dn_1
)

plot_gene_sets(
  genelists,
  mat,
  # mat_cols = c(1:4, 9:12)
  colorScale = myColors,
  heatmapColsplits = myColsplits,
  plotType = "venn"
)
```

Q2a.1: effect of just going with the P-value (i.e., drop fold criteria?) Does it collapse into a single group. **AG: Yes, collapses. We also bring in HES1 and ID2 in addition to ADAMTS15. The first 2 genes are actually pretty interesting!**

```{r}
wt_dn_258 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "WT", sig == "dn") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

ko_dn_1 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "TAK1KO", rescue == "naive", sig == "dn") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

union = unique(c(wt_dn_258, ko_dn_1))

# pull pool genes, then drop to pvalue criteria only only

wt_dn_l2f_dropped = dea %>%
  filter(condition == "WT", Gene %in% union) %>%
  filter(FDR <= 0.05, log2fold < 0) %>%
  pull(Gene)

ko_dn_l2f_dropped = dea %>%
  filter(group == "TAK1KO_naive", Gene %in% union) %>%
  filter(FDR <= 0.05, log2fold < 0) %>%
  pull(Gene)

genelists = list(
  wt_dn_l2f_dropped = wt_dn_l2f_dropped,
  ko_dn_l2f_dropped = ko_dn_l2f_dropped
)

plot_gene_sets(
  genelists,
  mat,
  # mat_cols = 1:8,
  colorScale = myColors,
  heatmapColsplits = myColsplits,
  plotType = "euler"
)

cleanup_objects()
```

## Downregulated: WT vs rescue:

Q4a: how many genes downreg in KO compared to wt? **AG: only 18.99% of downregulation events are rescued. 23 unique downregulation events occur. These are: ADGRF3, BCL9, BEND3P1, CARNS1, FDXACB1, GCNT1, GVQW3, GZF1, INKA1, KCTD7, MIDN, MTNR1A, OSR1, RIMBP3C, SERTAD3, SPRY2, STX1A, TET1, ZNF281, ZNF367, ZNF395, ZNF396, ZNF555.**

```{r}
wt_dn_258 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "WT", sig == "dn") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

rescue_dn_72 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "TAK1KO", rescue == "TAK1-smRNA", sig == "dn") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

genelists = list(
  wt_dn_258 = wt_dn_258,
  rescue_dn_72 = rescue_dn_72
)

plot_gene_sets(
  genelists,
  mat,
  # mat_cols = c(1:4, 9:12, 17:20),
  plotType = "euler",
  colorScale = myColors,
  heatmapColsplits = myColsplits
)
```

Q4a.1: take the above Venn and drop the log2fold criteria? See if it collapses. **AG: good collapse. 11 unique genes are: ADGRF3, BEND3P1, CARNS1, FDXACB1, GCNT1, INKA1, MTNR1A, RIMBP3C, SPRY2, ZNF367, ZNF396. Would trust these more bc log2fold threshold feels unreliable for downregulated genes.**

```{r}

wt_dn_258 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "WT", sig == "dn") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

rescue_dn_72 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "TAK1KO", rescue == "TAK1-smRNA", sig == "dn") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

union = unique(c(wt_dn_258, rescue_dn_72))

# re-establish gene pools with l2f threshold dropped

wt_dn_l2f_dropped = dea %>%
  filter(
    condition == "WT", 
    FDR <= 0.05,
    Gene %in% union
    ) %>%
  pull(Gene)

rescue_dn_l2f_dropped = dea %>%
  filter(
    condition == "TAK1KO",
    rescue == "TAK1-smRNA",
    FDR <= 0.05,
    Gene %in% union
  ) %>%
  pull(Gene)

genelists = list(
  wt_dn_l2f_dropped = wt_dn_l2f_dropped,
  rescue_dn_l2f_dropped = rescue_dn_l2f_dropped
)

plot_gene_sets(
  genelists,
  mat,
  plotType = "euler",
  colorScale = myColors,
  heatmapColsplits = myColsplits
)

cleanup_objects()


```

Q4b: effect of introducing native TAK1 smRNA to TAK1KO? **AG: 88.8% of wt_dn_258 folds moved back to negative in response to rescue. i.e., 88.8% of downregulations got rescued. 12.4% of all fold differentials were significant.**

```{r, fig.height=3, fig.width=4}

  filter(condition == "WT", sig == "dn") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

rescue_dn_72 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "TAK1KO", rescue == "TAK1-smRNA", sig == "dn") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

df = rescue_interaction %>%
  filter(Gene %in% wt_dn_258)

hist(df$log2diff, breaks = 100)

hist(df$FDR, breaks = 100)

df %>%
  mutate(
    direction = case_when(
      log2diff == 0  ~ "0 or NA log2diff",
      log2diff <= 0 ~ "-ve log2diff",
      log2diff >= 0  ~ "+ve log2diff"
    )
  ) %>%
  count(direction) %>%
  mutate(percent = 100*n/sum(n)) %>%
  knitr::kable(full_width = FALSE)

df %>%
  mutate(sig = if_else(FDR <= 0.05, "FDR<=0.05", "ns")) %>%
  count(sig) %>%
  mutate(percent = 100*n/sum(n)) %>%
  knitr::kable(full_width = FALSE)

cleanup_objects()
```

Q4c: compare WT and rescued IL1B response? **AG: folds for 5.04% of wt_dn_258 were significantly different in rescue compared to WT. ie WT and rescued downregulations look highly similar.**

```{r, fig.height=3, fig.width=4}
wt_rescue_interaction = read_tsv("data/wt_vs_rescued_interaction_test.txt")

wt_dn_258 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "WT", sig == "dn") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

df = as.data.frame(wt_dn_258, nm = "Gene") %>%
  left_join(
    wt_rescue_interaction %>% 
      select(Gene, log2diff, FDR)
    )

hist(df$log2diff, breaks = 100)
# summary(df$log2diff)

hist(df$FDR, breaks = 100)
# summary(df$FDR)

df %>%
  mutate(
    direction = case_when(
      log2diff == 0  ~ "0 or NA log2diff",
      log2diff <= 0 ~ "-ve log2diff",
      log2diff >= 0  ~ "+ve log2diff"
    )
  ) %>%
  count(direction) %>%
  mutate(percent = 100*n/sum(n)) %>%
  knitr::kable(full_width = FALSE)

df %>%
  mutate(sig = if_else(FDR <= 0.05, "FDR<=0.05", "ns")) %>%
  count(sig) %>%
  mutate(percent = 100*n/sum(n)) %>%
  knitr::kable(full_width = FALSE)

cleanup_objects()
```

## Downregulated: WT vs rescue:

Q5a: How many genes significant in wt vs D175A? **AG: 3.5% of wt_dn_258 appears rescued.**

```{r}

wt_dn_258 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "WT", sig == "dn") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

mutant_dn_13 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "TAK1KO", rescue == "mTAK1-smRNA", sig == "dn") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

genelists = list(
  wt_dn_258 = wt_dn_258,
  mutant_dn_13 = mutant_dn_13
)

plot_gene_sets(
  genelists,
  mat,
  # mat_cols = c(1:4, 9:12, 17:20),
  plotType = "euler",
  colorScale = myColors,
  heatmapColsplits = myColsplits
)

cleanup_objects()
```

Q5a.2: correlations for wt_dn_258: WT vs D175A. **AG: worse than the native rescue as expected.**

```{r fig.height=2, fig.width=4}
wt_dn_258 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "WT", sig == "dn") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

df = tpm %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = unique(group))) %>%
  filter(
    Gene %in% wt_dn_258,
    group %in% c("WT_naive", "TAK1KO_mTAK1-smRNA"),
    treatment == "IL1B"
  ) %>%
  select(Gene, group, log2fold) %>%
  group_by(Gene, group) %>%
  summarize(log2fold = mean(log2fold), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "group", values_from = "log2fold")

pearson = cor.test(df[,2][[1]], df[,3][[1]], method = "pearson")$estimate[[1]]

deming = deming(`TAK1KO_mTAK1-smRNA`~WT_naive, df)
deming_intercept = deming$coefficients[[1]]
deming_slope = deming$coefficients[[2]]

info = paste0(
  "Pearson=", round(pearson, 2), 
  "; slope=", round(deming_slope, 2),
  "; intercept=", round(deming_intercept, 2)
  )

ggplot(df, aes(x = WT_naive, y = `TAK1KO_mTAK1-smRNA`)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, fill = "white") +
  geom_abline(slope = deming_slope, intercept = deming_intercept, color = "blue") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_prismLike +
  labs(caption = info) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, -4.2)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, -4.2))

cleanup_objects()
```

Q5c: compare WT and rescued IL1B response? **AG: 97.7% of fold downregulations are higher in wt than the D175A rescue. 72.9% significantly so. i.e., for most genes, the mutant is worse at downregulating than wt.**
